user_problem: A defined event needs a coordinated set of promotional artifacts without inventing schedule, speakers, or benefits.
unique_output: An asset plan listing artifact purpose, required facts, dependency, audience, deadline relation, and content boundary.
required_input: Event facts, approved audience, confirmed schedule, speaker permissions, channel list, and production milestones.
critical_rule: Unconfirmed event details remain placeholders and cannot be converted into promotional promises.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is marketing-campaign-brief; this specifies a bounded event asset set rather than overall campaign strategy.
acceptance_scenario: Input confirms a June 4 webinar, speaker Lee approved for web only, registration closes June 3, channels web and email. Output plans both assets but limits Lee's name to web and uses only confirmed dates.
